items.reason: The record registers 'Methimazole (other names: Northyx, Tapazole)'. Methimazole is the US adopted name, and the INN for the same moiety is thiamazole; the manual requires INN spelling (as in its phytomenadione example). It is the same agent, so candidate status is unchanged.

Both coders mean the same thing: 'secondary chemotherapy will be added at the treating physician's discretion' after the first 4-week methimazole cycle. The difference is wording only, and regimen 'combination' is agreed.

note: Not queued, but worth a look: inclusion is 'WHO grade 4 glioma (including tumors with molecularly defined grade 4 astrocytoma)'. That may admit IDH-mutant grade 4 astrocytoma, which would make the population mixed_glioma_gbm_named rather than gbm_only. Both coders kept gbm_only because the title and conditions name glioblastoma. It is included either way. No D31 convention changes any value (target_engagement 'yes' has a described measurement, peripheral blood H2S, so D31-C6 does not apply); nothing pending for XL.
